semiconductor_relevance: High — The National Institute for Materials Science provides advanced equipment and services crucial for semiconductor device prototyping and process development.
summary: The National Institute for Materials Science (NIMS) offers specialized equipment and services for semiconductor device prototyping and process development. Their expertise includes advanced lithography and thin film deposition technologies, as well as sophisticated etching processes and material characterization tools.
capabilities: Thin film deposition technologies including CVD and ALD
Advanced etching processes like ICP-RIE and DRIE
